activity_statements.statement: builds and sells single-family homes across 19 markets in 13 states as one of the largest privately held US home builders (125,000+ homes sold since 1976)
operates four distinct product lines targeting different buyer segments: flagship David Weekley, entry-level Imagination, urban-infill Central Living, and 55+ low-maintenance Encore
manages land acquisition, design, purchasing, construction, and customer care as vertically integrated functions of a single private home builder
differentiates on design quality, earning 880+ design awards and the Triple Crown of American Home Building (only builder to receive this distinction)
operates in major Sun Belt and growth markets including Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio, Denver, Nashville, Phoenix, Atlanta, and others

name_reality_gap: The 'Construction' index label is accurate. The company is straightforwardly a home builder. Less obvious: its conservative private ownership has enabled it to avoid the land-speculation risks that have hurt public home builders, and its design-first differentiation makes it look more like an architecture-forward company than a typical production builder.
extraction_notes: About page was very detailed and informative with history, product lines, geographic reach, awards, and financial philosophy.
